units.notes: This was a second look at the plant location only. No other field was researched for this unit.

Latitude.note: The Kansas Register of October 23, 2025 carries the state air permit notice for the Viola Energy Center. It places the plant near the corner of North Milan Road and West 50th Avenue North, near Conway Springs in Sumner County. Evergy's air permit application from 2025 has an area map that labels the plant at 37.333425, -97.671517, and a plot plan that draws the combustion turbine and heat recovery boiler in the field east of North Milan Road, just northeast of the Viola substation. The state's permit summary gives the project center in map grid coordinates that convert to 37.33424, -97.67223, about 110 meters from the area map point. Both permit documents have been taken off the state health department website, so I read the archived copies and cite the Kansas Register notice, which is still online. In the satellite picture I saw that parcel: a farm field bounded by North Milan Road on the west and woods on the east, with the Viola substation to its southwest and West 50th Avenue North to its south. The point falls where the plot plan puts the turbine. The picture shows bare farmland. Its date is unknown and it is older than the May 2026 groundbreaking, so no plant buildings show yet. GEM's current point matches the EIA generator table and sits about 250 meters to the southeast, at the edge of the woods. The new point is on the power block parcel itself, so I call it exact.

qa.recommendation: Use the Kansas Register notice of October 23, 2025 for the Viola plant, https://sos.ks.gov/publications/Register/Volume-44/Issues/Issue-43/10-23-25-53577.html, as the source for City. Drop the November 27, 2025 notice from the City sources.
qa.note: The first look cited a Kansas Register notice from November 27, 2025 for the City value. That notice is about the McNew Energy Center in Reno County, not this plant. The October 23, 2025 notice is the one for Viola. It says the plant is near Conway Springs, Sumner County, so the City value Conway Springs still holds.

On October 23, 2026 fetch.py still returned page not found, and a Wayback Machine lookup for this exact address found a saved copy from November 30, 2025, which is read and listed in the next entry.
